tiers.label: S — essential
tiers.events: Central-bank decisions, policy guidance and projections; major inflation releases; the most important employment reports.

tiers.label: A — major
tiers.events: Wages, flash PMIs/ISM, first GDP estimates, retail sales, other important labour indicators.

tiers.label: B — supporting
tiers.events: Producer prices, industrial production, business/consumer confidence, trade balance, housing.

tiers.label: C — secondary
tiers.events: Routine minor surveys, lower-profile speeches, duplicate final estimates with little new information.

USD.S: FOMC decision/guidance/projections; CPI/core CPI; employment report, including payrolls, unemployment and earnings
USD.A: Core PCE; ISM services/manufacturing; retail sales; advance GDP; employment cost index
USD.B: Claims, JOLTS, PPI, confidence, housing, industrial production

EUR.S: ECB decision/press conference/projections; euro-area flash headline/core HICP
EUR.A: Flash PMIs; wage indicators; first GDP estimate; German inflation as an early input
EUR.B: Ifo, ZEW, retail sales, industrial production, unemployment

GBP.S: BoE decision/vote split/projections; CPI and services inflation; labour report, especially wages
GBP.A: Monthly GDP; flash PMIs; retail sales
GBP.B: Business investment, industrial production, confidence, housing

JPY.S: BoJ decision/guidance/Outlook Report; national and Tokyo CPI
JPY.A: Wage data; Tankan; first GDP estimate
JPY.B: Retail sales, industrial production, trade, household spending

CAD.S: BoC decision/guidance/projections; CPI including trim/median; employment report
CAD.A: Monthly/quarterly GDP; retail sales; wage details

AUD.S: RBA decision/guidance/projections; headline/underlying CPI; employment report
AUD.A: GDP; wage price index; household spending

NZD.S: RBNZ OCR decision/guidance/projections; CPI; labour report
NZD.B: Business confidence, manufacturing/services surveys, trade, dairy auctions
